validity.researcher_notes: P3185 is confirmed as the Three Rivers Interconnection Project (Alliance Pipeline LP, docket CP21-113, lateral serving the Three Rivers Energy Center power plant in Illinois). EIA project match is strong: length 2.87 mi (sheet) vs 2.85 mi (EIA, close within rounding), diameter 20 in (match), capacity 210 MMcf/d (match), in-service 2024 (match). Status operating confirmed — the project was completed in 2024 per EIA. CAVEAT: SegmentCost differs materially — sheet records $39.31M but EIA shows $27.7M in the most recent (Aug 2026) release. This 42% discrepancy needs clarification: either the sheet's cost includes financing/interest, or EIA's figure is incomplete, or one source has an error. Without the FERC Form 121 (which would show the authorized cost), cannot determine which is correct. Route geometry matches (ThreeRiversInterconnection lateral in Illinois, Grundy County area, coordinates 41.41°N, 88.29°W). Conclusion: pipeline is real, correctly classified (transmission lateral), all major specs confirmed except cost — the cost discrepancy is flagged but does not invalidate the pipeline or its status.
